integrity: The proof is an exact hyperspace-factor argument using the published generalized definition and the standard amenable invariant-measure lifting theorem. No finite computation, numerical experiment, or external certification is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a locally compact second-countable amenable acting group and proves only factor heredity. It does not assert a converse, extension permanence, a nonamenable analogue, or existence/classification of nontrivial factors of the horocycle examples.
title: Generalized IC-rigidity is inherited by factors
